intent: The workspace/team management dialog: a tabbed modal for viewing members and their roles (Members) and editing the team name and description (Settings).
guidance: One component renders both tabs; `tab` controls the active one (uncontrolled, it defaults to "settings"). It is presentational: it shows only what the host passes, and every "Change name", "Add a description", role change, and Remove is a host callback. An affordance with no wired callback renders muted or static text, never a live control that silently drops the action. With one or fewer members the Members tab shows a permissions helper caption instead of the "Team · N members" summary. Radix Dialog supplies the focus trap, Escape-to-close, aria-modal, and body portal; sections are separated by whitespace only, with no dividers.

anatomy.description: 40px top bar with a bottom border (ModalHeader variant="tabs"). Holds the Members/Settings tabs; the "Team" title is a visually hidden (sr-only) DialogTitle.
24px X button at the header's right edge, aria-label "Close".
Scrollable content region (ModalBody, px-24 py-8): a team-icon column beside a 472px-max content column.
80px square glyph — a photo (teamIconSrc) or a white Users icon on multiplayer grey.
Settings tab: a "Team name" section (value + "Change name" link) and an "About" section ("Add a description" link).
Members tab: a permissions helper caption or a "Team · N members" summary, then the list of member rows.
Avatar, name (+ muted "(You)"), optional email, and a role control; pending rows render at 60% opacity.
"Owner" shows as static text; editable roles open a dark dropdown (Can edit / Can view + Remove); unwired roles show static text.

use_when: Managing a workspace/team: reviewing members and their roles, or editing the team name and description.
You need one dialog that switches between a Members roster and Settings via tabs.
dont_use_when: A blocking confirm or alert — use a plain Modal (width "dialog") with ModalFooter actions.
Sharing a document with people or links — use ShareModal.
Editing a single field inline — use InputField in a form, not a full dialog.

Heading.note: size/line-height hardcoded 14px/24px, not a type token

Value.note: size/line-height hardcoded 11px/16px, not a type token

Backdrop.note: scrim hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.4) (special/modalbackdrop, defined in Modal)

tokens.note: Not token-only: the TeamIcon background is a hardcoded #667799 hex, the modal scrim is a hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.4), and the heading/value type sizes are hardcoded px rather than type tokens.

a11y.role: dialog (Radix Dialog.Content with aria-modal, focus trap, Escape-to-close, body portal). The role and aria-modal are provided by Radix, not a literal role attribute in source.
a11y.title: A DialogTitle is always rendered for assistive tech — visually hidden (sr-only) on the tabs header, where the tab list replaces the visible "Team" title.
a11y.menu: The role dropdown is a Radix DropdownMenu — portalled, dark, and keyboard-navigable.

code.example: <TeamDialog open={open} onClose={close} tab={tab} onTabChange={setTab} teamName="Acme" members={members} onChangeMemberRole={setRole} onRemoveMember={remove} />
